holes_found.description: INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY between detail_evidence and detail_verdict_text (this is the drifted field). detail_verdict_text para 2 asserts: 'The numerical value is textbook physics (Part 3.1b, trivial-transcription test): it appears in undergraduate references and widely indexed resources.' But detail_evidence establishes the dome's value 4.87e-12 rad/s^2 is (a) dimensionally wrong (acceleration not velocity) and (b) 37% below the real value even after charitable unit correction. A value that is 37% off and in the wrong units is by definition NOT a value that 'appears in undergraduate references' - the textbook value is 7.73e-12 rad/s (50.2881 arcsec/yr), which the dome did NOT transcribe. A dome defender can exploit the contradiction: 'Your review can't simultaneously say my number fails on value/units AND that it is a trivial transcription of a textbook value - those are mutually exclusive.' The PHENOMENON (axial precession) is textbook and predates the dome (post_hoc holds on that basis), but the specific NUMBER is not textbook.
holes_found.recommendation: Reword detail_verdict_text para 2 so the post-hoc/trivial-transcription point attaches to the PHENOMENON, not the dome's specific number: e.g. 'Earth's axial precession and its ~50 arcsec/yr rate are textbook physics predating the dome by millennia, so labeling precession-exists a confirmed prediction is post-hoc - regardless that the dome's own quoted number (4.87e-12 rad/s^2) does not even reproduce the textbook value.' Drop the literal 'the numerical value is textbook physics ... appears in undergraduate references' phrasing, which our own evidence contradicts.

holes_found.description: UNVERIFIED + NUMERICALLY SELF-UNDERMINING ATTRIBUTION. detail_evidence states: 'The dome's own page text frames this as a precession rate matching the 25,772-year cycle (a velocity-class quantity, the same type as the IAU 2006 value).' Two problems: (1) our raw-text mirror does NOT contain any 25,772-year framing for WIN-021 - the sole dome reference (raw-text/02-wins.txt:106) reads only 'Gyroscopic Precession Rate CONFIRMED (4.87e-12 rad/s^2)'; the 25,772-year cycle framing is not attributable to the dome from our sources. (2) It is numerically wrong: 4.87e-12 read as a velocity gives a period of 2pi/4.87e-12 ~= 40,883 years, NOT 25,772 years (ratio 1.59x). So the dome's number does not 'match the 25,772-year cycle' even under the velocity reading. The anti-retreat argument (defenders can't claim 'we meant acceleration') rests solely on the dome's published word 'Rate' and needs no 25,772-year claim.
holes_found.recommendation: Delete the 'matching the 25,772-year cycle' clause. Replace with something the mirror supports: 'The dome's own published label is Gyroscopic Precession Rate - a rate (velocity-class) quantity - so the acceleration reading is a defender retreat the published claim does not make.' Keep the 25,772-year cycle only where we introduce it as EARTH's real precession period (which our own computation confirms), not as the dome's framing of its own number.

stronger_arguments.description: The cleanest single kill for WIN-021 is that the dome's number fails EVERY reading: as an acceleration it is ~12.7 orders of magnitude larger than Earth's real secular precession acceleration (~1.05e-24 rad/s^2) and would produce a 2e7 one-year runaway VLBI/LLR would have caught; as a velocity it is 37% below Earth's 7.73e-12 rad/s and corresponds to a ~40,883-year period, matching nothing. Leading with 'there is no unit under which this number is correct' is stronger and cleaner than the post-hoc/trivial-transcription framing, which (per holes_found[0]) is internally awkward for a non-matching value.

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome is right that axial precession is a real, well-quantified phenomenon with a ~25,772-year cycle and a rate near 50 arcsec/yr (WIN-021 detail_evidence; IAU 2006 P03, DOI 10.1051/0004-6361:20031539). A tau = I*alpha / gyroscopic framing of precession is also legitimate physics - precession genuinely arises from luni-solar torque on the equatorial bulge.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Being right that precession exists does not make 4.87e-12 rad/s^2 a correct or predicted value. The dome's number is dimensionally wrong (rad/s^2 for a rate) and, corrected to rad/s, 37% off the measured 7.73e-12 rad/s (WIN-021 detail_evidence; verified in this review's quantitative_verification). There is no derivation from dome geometry (code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome=false; raw-text/02-wins.txt:106 carries no math) and no automation checks it (monitoring=none). Getting the physics category right while missing the number and the units is exactly the 'Misleading' pattern.

advocate_mode.best_defense: A dome defender who has read our own six methodological principles will now attack the SEAM our review just opened: 'Your review is internally incoherent. Your Evidence section proves my 4.87e-12 is 37% away from the textbook value and in the wrong units - i.e. a NOVEL, non-standard number. Your Verdict section then convicts me under the trivial-transcription/post-hoc test, which requires that I copied a KNOWN textbook value. I can't have both copied the textbook value and be 37% away from it. Pick one: either my number is the standard value (and your units/mismatch critique collapses) or it is not the standard value (and your post-hoc you-just-transcribed-textbook-physics critique collapses). Moreover your own text mis-states my claim - you say I frame it as matching the 25,772-year cycle, but 4.87e-12 as a rate is a 40,900-year period; you invented a framing to knock down.' This is the strongest remaining move and it targets our text, not the physics.
advocate_mode.preemptive_recommendation: Apply both holes_found fixes. Separate the two independent critiques cleanly: (1) the NUMBER fails on its own terms (wrong units; 37% off as a velocity; 12.7 orders off as an acceleration; matches no period) - this is the empirical kill and needs no post-hoc framing; (2) the phenomenon of precession predates the dome, so claiming precession-is-confirmed adds nothing - this is the post-hoc point, and it must attach to the phenomenon, never to the dome's specific (wrong) number. Once separated, the you-can't-have-it-both-ways defense evaporates because we are no longer asserting the dome's number is a textbook value.

cross_win_consistency.notes: The Part 3.1b trivial-transcription / post-hoc argument is applied across the monitoring:none, post_hoc:true, derives_from_dome:false cluster. In WIN-001 (Tesla 11.78 Hz ~ Schumann), WIN-050/051 (tidal periods), WIN-033 (25,772-yr precession cycle) the dome's quoted VALUE MATCHES the known value, so 'trivial transcription' fits cleanly. WIN-021 is the outlier: the dome's value does NOT match (37% off + wrong units). Applying the identical 'the numerical value is textbook physics' phrasing to a non-matching case is not a hard contradiction with the other WINs, but it is a consistency WEAKNESS - the label 'trivial transcription' silently assumes value-match everywhere except here. Fixing holes_found[0] (attach post-hoc to the phenomenon, not the number) restores clean cross-WIN consistency. Also cross-checked: WIN-033 legitimately uses the 25,772-yr cycle as Earth's real precession period; our WIN-021 use of 25,772 yr as Earth's period is consistent - the problem is only the clause attributing that period to the DOME's number (holes_found[1]).

NEW: 2pi/4.87e-12/yr_s=40,883 yr - the dome's value as a velocity is a 40,883-yr period, 1.59x the 25,772-yr cycle, so it does NOT 'match the 25,772-year cycle' (feeds holes_found[1]).

deeper_analysis: The verdict 'Misleading' is correct and robustly supported by the units error, the 37% value mismatch, the absence of any dome-geometry derivation, and the absence of monitoring automation - all re-verified this cycle. The two c4 minor holes are resolved. The +8% drift in detail_verdict_text (the growth of the post-hoc paragraph) is what this re-review targets, and it is exactly where the two new moderate holes live: (1) the post-hoc 'the numerical value is textbook physics' phrasing contradicts our own evidence that the value is 37% off and dimensionally wrong; (2) the detail_evidence attributes a 25,772-year cycle framing to the dome that our mirror does not support and that our own math contradicts (the dome's value as a velocity is a 40,883-yr period). Neither hole touches the verdict - both are text-hygiene fixes that close defender seams. Recommend minor_edit.
